missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Волна' is the nominative subject of 'накрыла'. 'Большая' is the agreeing feminine adjective, and 'берег' is the accusative object.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Волну' is the accusative direct object of 'любят'. 'Высокую' agrees in the feminine accusative, describing the size of the wave.
Strategic focus: Prepositional of location. 'На волне' uses the prepositional form 'волне' after 'на' to mark where the boat rocks. A vivid sea image.
Strategic focus: Genitive after 'от'. 'Волны' is genitive following 'от' to express the cause of the motion. 'Большой' agrees in the feminine genitive.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of means. 'Волной' is instrumental, the manner in which the sea met them. 'Сильной' agrees in the feminine instrumental.
Strategic focus: Dative after 'навстречу'. 'Волне' is the dative required by 'навстречу', expressing movement toward something. A natural swimming scene.
Strategic focus: Genitive after 'после'. 'Волны' is genitive following 'после' to mark a point in time. 'Большой' agrees in the feminine genitive.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural object. 'Волны' is the accusative plural object of 'поднимает'; for inanimate nouns the plural accusative matches the nominative. 'Большие' agrees in the plural.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Волны' is the nominative plural subject of the sentence. 'Высокие' agrees in the plural, describing the rough sea conditions.
Strategic focus: Prepositional plural. 'О морских волнах' uses the prepositional plural after 'о' to mark the topic. 'Морских' agrees in the plural.
